json.notes: The Musée d'Orsay is a long cream limestone former railway station on the Seine. Its river front has a central clock pavilion with a steep slate mansard roof, flanked by pavilion blocks at each end. Behind the stone facade, a long glass-and-iron barrel vault runs along the length of the hall. I model the stone facade masses, the clock pavilion with its clock face, the end pavilions with mansard roofs, and the vault roof.
